sentence: This project builds computer methods that study the evolutionary history of organisms using DNA and other biomolecular sequence data.
This project builds AI models that follow physics laws to predict how atoms pack together to form crystal structures.
This project uses AI to detect microbial pathogens and chemical contaminants in aquaculture, livestock and related agricultural environments.
This project gets a tool that uses an electron beam to make nanoscale structures over large areas.
This project uses artificial intelligence to measure how cerebrospinal fluid flows deep inside the brain.
This project builds hands-on virtual labs that teach how to offload network and security tasks from a server's processor to a network interface card.
This project builds a chip with magnetic memory that carries out AI processing inside the memory.
This project studies how conversational AI and speech recognition can support children's learning in hands-on science exhibits.
This project studies how an embryonic gene network that specifies the gut in nematodes underwent expansion over evolutionary time.
This project builds a system that observes each layer in laser powder bed fusion and applies a repair to recoater streaks.
This project builds a robot from a network of inflatable balloons that can change shape and lift loads.
This project studies the computational properties of tensors and tries to find out when two given objects have the same structure.
This project develops a way for many computers to learn together while exchanging only single numerical values.
This project builds a framework that uses computer vision and deep learning to create digital twins of manufacturing shop floors.
This project builds prototype microfluidic devices using industrial-scale roll-to-roll manufacturing.
This project brings together scientists to explore how living organisms grow, develop, repair and regenerate cell types and tissues.
This project studies how pathogenic bacteria specialize on a common host and acquire infectivity on a different host.
